# ScramBuffer

*Common*

Key-value data that scripts send in script packets. Values are stored as BBS data types. Getters return the default value when the key is missing or holds a value of another type.

## Methods

### addString {#addstring}

::: member

Stores a string.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | value key, 1 to [`MAX_KEY_LENGTH`](#max_key_length) characters. |
| `value` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | string of at most [`MAX_STRING`](#max_string) characters. |

**Returns** [`ScramBuffer`](/scripting/common/ScramBuffer) — this buffer.

:::
